section:
Data Structures Here are the data structures with brief descriptions:engine_component
A component used for the functionality of entities engine_context
The engine itself, nothing can function without this being initialized! engine_entity
An entity, contains position, size, texture, and component data engine_texture
A texture handle that contains all necessary texture information engine_texture_pair
Used to make a pseudo-dictionary for the engine linklist
A standard link list data structure window_config
The window config tells the engine how to setup the window
